results.question: average agreed price of completed bike sales in 2025
results.sql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.agreed_price)::numeric, 2) AS avg_agreed_price
FROM nlq.deals d
JOIN nlq.listings_all l ON d.item_id = l.item_id
JOIN nlq.categories c ON l.category = c.category
WHERE d.deal_type = 'sale'
  AND d.status = 'completed'
  AND d.completed_on BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  AND c.category = 'bikes_transport';
results.answer: The average agreed price of completed bike sales in 2025 was $184.51.

results.question: which meetup spot got the most new listings in spring 2026?
results.sql:
SELECT ms.name AS meetup_spot,
       COUNT(*) AS new_listings
FROM nlq.listings_all la
JOIN nlq.meetup_spots ms ON la.spot_id = ms.spot_id
JOIN nlq.calendar c ON la.listed_on = c.day
WHERE c.semester = 'Spring'
  AND c.academic_year = '2025-26'
  AND la.condition = 'new'
GROUP BY ms.name
ORDER BY new_listings DESC
LIMIT 1;
results.answer: Snell Library had the most new listings in Spring 2026, with 36 listings.

results.question: what share of all listings ever posted were offered for rent?

results.question: for each category, how many days on average does it take an item to sell?
results.sql:
SELECT la.category,
       round(avg(extract(epoch FROM d.completed_at - la.listed_at) / 86400)::numeric, 2) AS avg_days_to_sell
FROM nlq.deals d
JOIN nlq.listings_all la ON d.item_id = la.item_id
WHERE d.deal_type = 'sale'
  AND d.status = 'completed'
  AND d.completed_at IS NOT NULL
  AND la.listed_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY la.category
ORDER BY avg_days_to_sell DESC;
results.answer: Across all time, the average days to sell items are: other 12.08 days, furniture 11.61 days, textbooks 11.56 days, sports_outdoors 11.56 days, kitchen 11.49 days, electronics 11.40 days, dorm_essentials 11.39 days, clothing 11.32 days, and bikes_transport 11.20 days.

results.question: late-return rate for rentals due during finals compared with rentals due during regular classes
results.sql:
SELECT c.period AS due_period,
       COUNT(*) AS total_rentals,
       SUM(CASE WHEN d.returned_late THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_returns,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN d.returned_late THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 2) AS late_return_rate_percent
FROM nlq.deals d
JOIN nlq.calendar c ON d.rental_due_date = c.day
WHERE d.deal_type = 'rental'
  AND d.rental_returned_at IS NOT NULL
  AND c.period IN ('classes', 'finals')
GROUP BY c.period
ORDER BY c.period;
results.answer: There are 2742 rentals due during regular classes, with 539 late returns (19.66% rate), and 134 rentals due during finals, with 25 late returns (18.66% rate). The figures cover all time.

results.question: which category has the highest sell-through rate?
results.sql:
SELECT c.category, c.label, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE la.status = 'sold')::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE la.status IN ('available','reserved','sold')),0), 2) AS sell_through_rate_percent
FROM nlq.listings_all la
JOIN nlq.categories c ON la.category = c.category
WHERE la.is_for_sale = true
GROUP BY c.category, c.label
ORDER BY sell_through_rate_percent DESC
LIMIT 1;
results.answer: The category with the highest sell‑through rate is Sports & outdoors, with a rate of 79.97%.
